definitions.explanation: Direct negotiation or confrontation between parties to settle a dispute or press a demand, often a forceful face-to-face discussion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{談判|だんぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{談判|だんぱん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I bargained with the shop over the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{談判|だんぱん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I confronted the company president directly and got my salary raised.

notes:
Refers to negotiating face to face, often to press a demand or settle a dispute. It carries a more forceful, confrontational nuance than ordinary ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{談判|だんぱん}: direct negotiation; confronting someone in person
- {談判|だんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to negotiate or press a demand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: negotiation — the neutral, standard term, including formal business and diplomacy
- ⟦{掛|か}け{合|あ}う→掛け合う：05742_kakeau⟧: to negotiate with; take a matter up with — a more colloquial verb
